settings.heading: 1. How to earn points
settings.text:
You can earn qoins in multiple ways:

  • Submit Before & After Photos (50 Points) – Share your skincare journey with Qure by submitting before and after photos.
  • Subscribe to Our Newsletter (50 Points) – Stay updated and earn points when you sign up.
  • Subscribe to YouTube (20 Points) – Follow us for expert skincare tips and exclusive content.
  • Follow Us on TikTok (10 Points) – Stay connected and discover the latest trends.
  • Join Our Instagram Community (10 Points) – Be part of our skincare community.
  • Shop & Earn (1 Point per $1 Spent) – Earn points with every purchase.

settings.heading: 2. How to redeem your points
3. How do referrals work?
settings.text: Give your friend 10% off their first skin-vestment, and earn 150 points for each new member you introduce to the Skin I-Q Club.

settings.heading: 4. How do I check my balance?
settings.text: Your qoins balance is displayed at the top of your rewards page once you're logged into your account. You can also select "Reward History" to view your redeemed rewards.

settings.heading: 5. Does it cost anything to begin earning points?
settings.text: No, signing up is completely free! You can start earning qoins even without making a purchase.

settings.heading: 6. Can I return an item I redeemed with a reward?
settings.text: Once a reward has been redeemed, it cannot be changed or returned.

settings.heading: 7. How long do my points last?
settings.text:
• Points expire if there is no transaction activity in your account for 365 days.
  • Rewards (points earned) expire 90 days from the date they are earned.
